Name: sophie leggatt
Review: SECOND REVIEWThe 4 weeks fundamental classes.If you’re starting from scratch, new to reformer, looking to feel part of a community, or keen to perfect your technique, then the 4 week fundamental classes are exactly what you need to book.Kelsey was our session queen - patient, supportive, passionate, friendly, professional and a TOTAL VIBE.Having now completed my final class, I feel much more connected to understanding the core basics of reformer. Thank you for creating such brilliant classes, they really are fantastic.I’m so excited for YOU, yes, YOU, the reader – to step into your own confidence and fall in love with reformer just as I have.X——————————FIRST REVIEWA studio that Banstead truly neededI have now done over 20+ classes and can honestly say it’s been one of the best decisions I’ve made for my wellbeing and just yesterday I began one of the 4-week Beginners Fundamentals course, which is such a wonderful way to really understand the techniques and build a strong foundation.As a complete first-timer to reformer Pilates, I was super nervous, all the usual thoughts of “Am I going to be good enough?” But from the very first session, I have never felt more confident, comfortable or welcomed. The atmosphere is calm, supportive and uplifting and every single teacher I’ve met – Kelsey, Koti, Alison, Zahra, Tamsin and Céline, has been nothing short of amazing. Each bring their own unique style and energy, but they all share the same warmth, patience and passion for what they do. You can really feel the care and love they put into every class.It’s more than just exercise – it’s an experience that nurtures both body and the mind and I really look forward to each session.Thank you for creating such a beautiful space and community.X

Name: Sophie C
Review: Such a gorgeous Pilates studio!! The instructors are so friendly and provide the most amazing classes.I love that you can reserve which reformer machine you are going to use for the class.I also really like the flexibility when booking packages in terms of the expiry dates and usage. It works really well!

Name: Jackie Penney
Review: I am quite new to reformer. But the Studio Glide environment was really welcoming. The classes were for mixed abilities and the instructors all extremely helpful and supportive throughout. Koti was my personal favourite, really helpful with posture while completing the exercises.Thoroughly recommend Studio Glide I loved it ❤️

Name: Francesca Bellometti
Review: I love going to Studio Glide, I started going in September and look forward to the classes so much. The studio space is relaxing and peaceful and the instructors are fantastic. It’s a great addition to Banstead High street and the range of timings of classes available work well with my busy schedule.

Name: Hannah Armah
Review: Excellent classes in a beautiful space. The instructors I’ve taken classes with have been extremely knowledgeable, observant and patient teaching me how to perform at my best. I really enjoy classes in this studio, feels like a calm space without distraction. Would highly recommend!

Name: Sarah johns
Review: I've really enjoyed attending these Studio Glide Pilates classes. Ive mostly been going to Koti's Thursday evening classes & shes very welcoming & gets you working hard, but also at your own pace & level, offering alternatives. The instructors ive met are all incredibly friendly, which makes such a difference, especially if you’re new or a bit nervous starting out. The environment is lovely—calm, supportive, and never intimidating. It’s a great place to focus on your fitness while also feeling comfortable and encouraged. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a positive and relaxing class atmosphere!

Name: Ann Hyett
Review: Sadly I’ve only managed to attend one class so far.I have hearing difficulties, and Celine was amazing at making sure I could hear and follow the instructions for each move and position. She was patient, clear, and very supportive. Definitely recommend Studio Glide — looking forward to booking my next class! 🙌

Name: Charlotte Ram
Review: Absolutely LOVE this studio! I came for the 2 week intro offer before Christmas and then tried another studio nearby and that didn't even compare! I love how challenging yet accessible the classes are and that fact that the studio itself is aesthetic makes me really motivated to go! I tried a few different instructors who were all great but I think my favourite was Tasmin, Koti and Celine for a really tough workout! I am rejoining as soon as I'm back in the UK!See you in March Studio Glide!

Name: Megan Reece
Review: I was nervous to try my first Reformer Pilates last year but the staff at Studio Glide couldn't have been more welcoming and reassuring. Every time I book a class, I leave feeling so much better. It's challenging but in the best kind of way and the staff are so kind, and help you really get the most out of each class. Fully recommend and always look forward to my trip to Studio Glide! Thank you!

Name: Ellie Taylor
Review: Love the classes at Studio Glide!! The instructors made me feel so welcome when I was starting out with Pilates. Now I can do the advanced classes and can’t wait to book more :)

Name: Ila Mehta
Review: I heard a lot of great benefits of reform pilates but did experience and realised this when I started with Studio glide. I am 62 years old and never did any pilates before but just doing my first 4 sessions I feel a significant difference in my body and flexibility. Teachers are very good and classes are really enjoyable for all levels. I would recommend this to all. Many Thanks 😊

Name: Gary C
Review: Outstanding Pilates studio. All the instructors have been super welcoming to me as a beginner. Alice, Koti & Alison are fantastic teachers. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking to start pilates!

Name: Molly Mae
Review: Such a fab studio and classes. The instructors are amazing. Definitely what Banstead high street needed!

Name: Catherine Meech
Review: Love this place! The classes are amazing! I have now done classes with 4 of the instructors here all with their own styles but similarities across them all. Very comprehensive explanation and they’re all so keen to help with adjustments to form, options to make the exercise easier or harder or just a bit of encouragement. The Pilates burn is so real! I’ve never done reformer before coming to studio glide and as someone who has done Pilates and danced as a child it’s a perfect mixture of trying something new but using movements I know. I started on the two week trial and now I'm hooked! It’s also such a good value in the area for such high quality classes.

Name: Brooke Walker-Smith
Review: Studio Glide is amazing I couldn’t recommend it more, the lessons are perfect for both beginners and advanced reformer girlies! All the instructors are lovely and really know their stuff, I feel so motivated and supported in classes. The playlists are also great paired with the workouts!

Name: Lois Kelly
Review: The studio and instructors are so welcoming and friendly! I was quite nervous to start reformer Pilates, but the sessions have been so positive and I’ve really enjoyed going ⭐️

Name: Charlotte Spears
Review: I highly recommend this studio for reformer pilates! The instructors are so friendly and knowledgeable. I’ve been to the pre and postnatal classes with Koti, and she’s fantastic! I’ve now also tried some of the signature classes where different levels of difficulty are always offered for you to choose. I always really look forward to going to the studio.

Name: Kelly Taylor
Review: Studio Glide is a beautiful studio, has easy parking nearby and amazing instructors. Having never really enjoyed exercise and not focussing on it at all for the last 4/5 years since having kids, I’ve finally found something I enjoy! I now have the 8 class monthly membership and try to go twice a week. The machines are great to use, everything is explained really well, everyone is so friendly and I love being able to book on the app. Highly recommend!

Name: Stephanie van de Wouw
Review: I’ve visited Studio Glide for the first time last week and absolutely loved the classes! The instructors are super friendly, the studio is clean and the classes are perfect for all levels. Looking forward to my upcoming classes! :)

Name: Gracie Mallett
Review: I’ve had a great experience at Studio Glide. The studio itself it’s super spacious, always kept clean and is a gorgeous space to workout in. All of the instructors I’ve had have been super welcoming and make you feel at ease, not to mention their great playlists! I would highly recommend Studio Glide to anyone wanting to get into/ back into reformer Pilates.

Name: Megan Young
Review: My first time trying reformer pilates, and Studio Glide made it such a fantastic experience.I have done a couple of classes now and all the instructors have been incredible, all the classes have been fantastic and I have left feeling amazing! Lovely Studio and environmentThank you!

Name: Stephanie Rouillon
Review: Great, local studio! All the instructors are great, I’ve enjoyed every class single class and the aching muscles after every class make Studio Glide addictive! 🧡

Name: Maddy Beck
Review: Absolutely love coming to classes at Studio Glide. Such a welcoming atmosphere with a beautiful studio and the most supportive instructors. Would highly recommend to anyone who is looking to begin or continue their Pilates journey!

Name: Georgia Vangelova
Review: I can’t recommend Studio Glide enough. The atmosphere is so welcoming and motivating. Every class leaves me and my friends feeling fresh.Celine and Tamsin are amazing — so knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely supportive. Their guidance makes all the difference. Truly the best place to train 🤍

Name: Luke
Review: My wife and I were trying to find a place to try reformer pilates for months. Someone mentioned Studio Glide to me at work and I am so glad that they did! We have nearly finished our introductory offer of 6 classes for £60. We have really enjoyed it. Studio Glide is a great place to get started with either reformer pilates or pilates in general. Highly recommend.

Name: Katherine Holloway
Review: I’ve been loving Studio Glide’s Pilates classes! They’re challenging but in a good way, and I’ve definitely noticed I’m getting stronger each week. The instructions are super clear, and the vibe is always really welcoming. I always leave feeling better than when I walked in. Would 100% recommend

Name: Sophie Knight
Review: Gorgeous studio. As a beginner, the instructor was welcoming and explained thoroughly how to use the machine which made me feel at ease. Class was easy to follow, but worked in all the right places and left me aching the next day!Would highly recommend!

Name: Gareth Davies
Review: My wife and I started Pilates with an introductory 4 week package last year. It was a great way to learn technique which led to us sticking with Kelsey and attending her classes on a Monday. They are well paced and structured in a way that they are suitable for all abilities. You definitely know you’ve had a workout by the end of the session.

Name: Vanessa Clark
Review: Loving my sessions with all the teachers at Studio Glide. I’m completely obsessed with Reformer Pilates and attend 2-3 classes a week. The studio is clean, bright and welcoming, and if life permitted I’d be there every day!

Name: Sandra Francis
Review: Loved my first taste of reformers Pilates. I was very conscious that I was both bigger and taller than most of the people at each class that I attended. Scary to begin with but Koti was so helpful in getting me (and everyone else) comfortable so that we got the most out of the class. I’d be a regular if it were more affordable.

Name: Helen M
Review: Great studio with classes that are challenging in all the right ways. Instructors are friendly, clear, and provide helpful corrections (which is great for beginners especially). Tamsin and Celine are my personal favourites, but all are very good. Recommend!

Name: Becca
Review: SECOND REVIEWI have now hit 10 classes at Studio Glide and I’m absolutely loving it! Every instructor I have had is calm, patient, always so helpful and knowledgeable. Even though it is a group class, you get individual feedback to help improve technique and ensure you are doing the moves correctly. The classes are affordable and easy to book on the app. I will definitely be adding Reformer Pilates at Studio Glide into my fitness routine!FIRST REVIEWI tried my first Reformer Pilates session at Studio Glide and absolutely loved it! I have always been nervous to try it but when I heard that Studio Glide was opening in Banstead, I was so excited and had to give it a go. Alice, my instructor was so welcoming, helpful and made me feel at ease straight away. I came away feeling confident and felt I had challenged myself. The studio is stunning and such a calm vibe. I have already booked my next class! I highly recommend Studio Glide.

Name: Stagecoach Farnborough
Review: Gorgeous studio and great classes. When I have the chance to go it’s my favouite part of the week.Little mention about a class I did a few months ago with Lauren! It was my the best!!

Name: Roxanne Tate
Review: I’ve been attending reformer Pilates classes at Studio Glide and couldn’t be happier. The space is clean, calming, and beautifully set up with high-quality reformer beds and a friendly welcoming atmosphere.The instructors are knowledgeable, professional, and supportive. Whether you’re a complete beginner or more experienced, they do sessions to suit your level and keep an eye on form and technique.The vibe is friendly, encouraging, and never intimidating (like you can fear) :)If you’re thinking of trying reformer Pilates then Studio Glide is a must.It’s been such a great addition to Banstead!!!!

Name: Vicky Panayi
Review: I absolutely love my Pilates classes at Studio Glide. Starting Reformer Pilates was definitely one of the best things that happened to me in 2025/26. The studio is bright and beautifully decorated and the instructors (shout out to Celine, Tamsin and Koti) are all warm, friendly and knowledgeable, their classes are fun but challenging and I always come away feeling great. Five months in to my pilates journey, I feel so much stronger, both physically and mentally. Thank you Studio Glide!

Name: Catriona Ballard
Review: I love the studio and the team at Studio Glide. I had only done one reformer class before I signed up a few weeks ago and now I am 8 classes down and obsessed!I already feel stronger and mentally lighter by going and can’t wait to see more results in the coming months.Keep the great work up ladies.Catriona

Name: Sheryl Lane
Review: Always come away from Studioglide feeling like I’ve had a great workout! Each instructor brings their own unique style to every class, so no two sessions are ever the same.

Name: liz sherlock
Review: Great studio on the high street with easy parking nearby. I am new to reformer and have felt welcome here. The instructors have suggested adaptations if needed . Looking forward to my next class.

Name: Jessica Butler
Review: The interior in Studio glide is stunning, offering a welcoming environment. The classes are great! You will definitely be feeling the burn after.

Name: Sarah Baxendale
Review: Have been going to Studio Glide since it first opened and still love it! The instructors are all great and will give lots of options to push yourself if you want to - I am definitely feeling stronger! Recommend to anyone wanting to get into reformer pilates 😊

Name: Ariana Bravo
Review: Gorgeous little studio. Really welcoming and great for all abilities. I’ve tried a handful of the instructors and they’ve all been fab, but a special shoutout to Celine 🫶🏽

Name: Sophie Sykes
Review: Lovely, clean and welcoming studio. I have had two different instructors so far and both were super friendly and made you feel at ease

Name: Sarah Farley
Review: Stunning studio and the most lovely instructors. Have really gained confidence on the reformer in the last few weeks of classes and can’t wait to go back! Obsessed with Studio Glide!

Name: Sophie Jackson
Review: I was a complete newbie to Reformer Pilates and I am so glad I started coming here at 9 weeks postpartum.The atmosphere is warm and welcoming. The instructor’s are so kind and friendly, giving beginner / advanced options to cater for all. The mama method classes are great for bringing your little one along 🥰Studio Glide is a fabulous addition to the High Street. Such a lovely welcoming space. Would recommend to everyone ❤️

Name: Naomi Hills
Review: Could not recommend highly enough, great workout in beautiful setting with a lovely group and knowledgable instructor. Celine made the class fun, helped me with my form and I felt like I had had a good workout

Name: Olivia Price
Review: Studio Glide is a great place for reformer Pilates. The instructors are friendly and knowledgeable, and the studio has a relaxed vibe. I’ve really enjoyed the classes so far. Highly recommend!

Name: Evie White
Review: Favourite reformer Pilates studio!! I go weekly to Koti’s Thursday 7pm class and it’s the best 50 minutes. Would recommend to everyone!

Name: Lauren Dempsey
Review: Such an awesome experience which leaves you feeling great. A beautiful space and excellent instructors who really work you. I love coming to these classes 😊

Name: Nicola Gainey
Review: I’m completely new to reformer Pilates and was a little nervous to start, but this studio has been such a welcoming place! The instructors are incredibly friendly, patient, and knowledgeable — they take the time to explain everything clearly and make sure you feel comfortable with the movements. I’ve already noticed how much stronger and more confident I feel after just a few classes. The space is stylish, clean, and has such a positive atmosphere. Highly recommend for anyone thinking about giving Pilates a try, whether you’re a total beginner like me or more experienced!

Name: Amy Molineaux-Say
Review: such a lovely atmosphere at studio glide & all the instructors are super welcoming! great classes :)

Name: Sophie
Review: Love this studio! I had an evening strength class with Kelsey and she was amazing! And so welcoming and lovely to chat to! X

Name: Jaylee Haskell
Review: This studio is amazing! Classes are amazing and are lead by a group of supportive and passionate ladies! Love it here :) highly reccommend

Name: The Daily Physio
Review: Such a wonderful space. Zahra is an incredible instructor! She reads the room and offers modifications / adjustments depending on people’s abilities to make the flow more or less challenging. Highly recommend.. I keep returning (at my own expense of sore muscles everywhere!!!!). Thank you!

Name: macy daws
Review: Beautiful studio very clean and tidy , the teachers are very supportive. variety of classes to attend to people’s needs. Overall would highly recommend 🤍✨

Name: Andrea Law
Review: I have been to several different classes at Studio Glide and have left each one feeling better and stronger. It's a lovely space, really calming and the beds are super easy to work out. Instructors are really helpful in giving adjustments and supporting you. I am aching in a thoroughly great way having used muscles i've perhaps neglected. Great introductory deal for new starters cost wise at unlimited classes for £60 within 2 weeks. Will be back.

Name: Hannah McHardie
Review: I have LOVED Studio Glide! For my first time trying reformer, all the instructors have been incredibly supportive and patient. The studio itself is beautifully calm and perfect for your pilates session with exceptional equipment. Big shout out to Celine for always being incredibly motivating and supportive and pushing us when we need it most!

Name: Shauna Matthews
Review: Fab studio, with an amazing team of instructors! I always look forward to classes, and am so glad I’ve finally found something that keeps me exercising consistently!

Name: P Bansal
Review: I love this studio! Tamsin is the loveliest instructor who always goes the extra mile to encourage me and she is the reason I have stuck with reformer now!

Name: Melissa Russell
Review: I hadn’t tried reformer Pilates until Studio Glide opened on my doorstep, so I was a complete beginner! I’ve been attending weekly classes since July, and I love how calm, supportive, and positive the sessions are. I would definitely recommend the studio to anyone thinking of starting reformer as a new hobby ⭐️

Name: Pauline Ullmann-Davis
Review: I think there’s not much to say other than - Wow! I have always been intrigued to try Reformer Pilates and when I saw that we will have this down the High Street I was so excited. And that excitement has not stopped. The classes I’ve attended so far have been challenging and transforming in the best way possible. All instructors are amazing, super helpful and very supportive throughout the class. Can only recommend everyone to give it a try!

Name: Chloe Ivens
Review: Lovely welcoming studio and instructors! Beautiful and relaxing setting, I love coming as a form of self care and movement 🧘🏼‍♀️💕

Name: jodie barker
Review: Studio Pilates is great. The classes are challenging and teachers are super supportive. Can’t recommend them enough.

Name: Jessica Ozdemir
Review: Studio Glide Pilates in Banstead is fantastic – the staff are so friendly and the instructors genuinely want you to enjoy and get the most from each class. The facilities are excellent, booking is super easy, and I always leave feeling like I’ve had a great workout. Highly recommend!

Name: Lisa Douglas
Review: Had my 3rd session today, two signature and 1 strength class so far, varied moves, great instructors, can't wait for the next class.

Name: Louie
Review: Very good instructors, quality reformer equipment and a relaxing studio. I feel so much comfort whilst doing the pilates.

Name: lisa kay
Review: Gorgeous studio, gorgeous instructors, gorgeous vibes! Have been attending weekly since opening and I have loved every class. All the classes are different, yet equally amazing. There’s always options to challenge yourself or to take it a bit more gently which I love! Unlike any other reformer classes I’ve done!

Name: Louise Gaudoin
Review: Lovely team, lovely studio and great classes! Really feel like I’m working total body and enjoying it at the same time! Come away from the class feeling both relaxed and that I’ve worked hard.

Name: Charlotte
Review: As a Pilates and group class complete novice, I had felt really anxious about turning up to a class. Luckily for me, my worries were completely unfounded - I was never once made to feel silly, or that this wasn’t an accessible space for newbies. I have experienced a few different instructors now and each of them pushed or corrected me when I needed it. The studio itself is beautiful and calming, and the fellow attendees are so lovely. Studio Glide feels like a calming, safe space and has become a new staple in my weekly routine.

Name: Ellena Saunders
Review: Thoroughly enjoyed my class at Studio Glide and so glad to rice brought a reformer studio to Banstead! The decor is stunning and everyone was super friendly! The music was also great and got us through those extra pulses!! Excited to book another class soon! 🫶🏼

Name: Molly Flynn
Review: The very best Pilates studio I have ever had the pleasure of going to. The most inclusive warm and friendly group of teachers who provide an epic workout but give options to ramp up or down the workout to suit you. On top of this the classes are held in the most serene space imaginable where you really feel at peace and can focus on getting the most out of your workout. I drive 40mins each way past 4 other studios to attend these classes and I would drive even further! Well done guys you are smashing it!

Name: Helen Sheppard
Review: Friendly team, welcoming studio, good size classes so that the instructors can ensure your technique is correct. Ever so slightly addictive!!

Name: Ellanah
Review: Fun mix of classes, friendly instructors, clean space! 2 week class pack is great value for money 10/10 would recommend

Name: Tulika Oommen
Review: Amazing reformer Pilates studio.All the teachers are great. The classes are very effective. Parking is very easy just outside. Really enjoyed the sessions

Name: Karis Smither
Review: I hadn’t done reformer Pilates before when I went to my first class because the studios were far away but once it came to Banstead I was hocked! The classes are amazing for beginners the instructions were really calm and I felt confident. I would 100% recommend if you’re a first timer :)

Name: Holly Cottam
Review: I have loved my experiences at Studio Glide so far! As a complete reformer beginner, the instructors have been nothing but supportive and encouraging. The studio is beautiful and well kept! I can’t wait to continue!!

Name: Chloe Brandon
Review: I have tried lots of reformer studios in the area and also in London but Studio Glide is by far my favourite! The studio is a beautiful zen space, the owners are lovely and ALL the instructors are amazing. Although there’s 10 to a class it still feels like you are getting that personal 1:1 treatment with hands-on corrections, modifications if needed and encouragement to push yourself that bit harder. Special shoutout to Celine and her Strength classes which always bring the burn in the best way!

Name: Natalia Hansell
Review: Can't recommend Studio Glide enough. I leave every class, no matter the instructor, feeling stronger and more energised (even if a little sore too!)

Name: Elspeth Pringle
Review: What a great place with wonderful instructors. I’ve just finished the introductory six classes in two weeks. I’ve had the great experience of three different instructors all of whom have been wonderful. They have taken time to explain the different moves, have adjusted poses where necessary and encouraged to stretch (no pun intended) oneself. If you are looking to try Reformer Pilates I would highly recommend Studio Glide in Banstead. The instructors I have experienced were Koti, Tamsin and Zhara.

Name: Laura Treadaway
Review: I regularly use studio glide, the instructors are very friendly and helpful .. and knowledgable, would highly recommend it to friends

Name: Victoria George
Review: Such a beautiful studio! And all the instructors I’ve had have been great!

Name: neve leask
Review: Such a lovely, calm and clean environment for a Pilates class! The instructors are encouraging, making sure you’re getting the most out of each session and pushing you to your full potential!

Name: sharon hoare
Review: Ae always great session..Absolutely love Celines classes. You definitely feel youve had a work out. Legs always ache lol

Name: Ella Perry
Review: Great studio, super friendly & enjoyed every class I did! Lots of variety & felt supper happy and fulfilled after each class! Every instructor is super helpful & kind, they’re all great!

Name: Vivienne Braidwood
Review: My finances have been really tight so I sadly had to give up reformer over a year ago and exercise at home. I couldn't believe it when I saw their opening 'unlimited' 2 week trial offer. I jumped at it !! Then I experienced the studio - absolutely amazing - so I was desperate to find a way to make it work even if only now and then.Fortunately, my friends and family saw how happy I was at Glide and pooled together to buy me a very generous voucher that meant I could sign up for a membership plan. I was so touched and have now decided that Glide vouchers are all I want for Birthdays, Christmas's etc.I'm already feeling the benefits of regular sessions on my mental and physical health and am feeling so optimistic about the future. Their team are amazing, the sessions exhilarating, the music spot on ! I'm absolutely in love with the place.Thank You Team Glide

Name: Sophie
Review: Such a beautiful studio! My first time doing Pilates and my instructor Lauren made me feel so welcome and relaxed and was so helpfull!! Feel very calm and relaxed in the studio and would highly recommend!! X

Name: Rowena Ovenstone
Review: Both workouts have been fabulous it’s a complete body workout. Both instructors give options to suit everyone’s needs and experience which is great. Also the ambience of the room is calming, music is always playing and everyone is there for the same reason you all share the same goal. Highly recommend it.

Name: Emma Barrett
Review: I love everything about Studio Glide, the vibe, the aesthetics, the instructors, the classes. If you haven't tried it yet, I couldn't recommend the studio more

Name: Jade Finlay
Review: I have been to two classes at studio glide and both times have really enjoyed it! Both instructors were friendly and welcoming! They took time to explain movements and make sure we were getting it right.

Name: Grace Beverley
Review: SUCH an incredible Pilates studio - exactly what the area needed. Classes are london standard (actually better), and you can tell they’re super selective with their instructors. Love that it’s owned by two local women too.

Name: holly turner
Review: I did Lauren’s class 2 weeks ago.. it was amazing, absolutely loved it! Beautiful studio, challenging but fun class! I was a newbie but felt safe and challenged! Will 100% be booking in again

Name: Sophie Lowdon
Review: I started back at the mama and baby class today and loved it. I am 7 weeks post partum and struggled to find a class that actually works your body whilst being able to bring your baby. The studio is beautiful and the instructor really guided me and challenged in the right way. Can’t wait to come back

Name: Catherine Ahern
Review: I absolutely love this place. The instructors are fantastic - they work you really hard, but are so lovely with it.

Name: Eleanor Meech
Review: Totally new to reformer pilates but I’ve felt so comfortable getting started at Studio Glide. Instructors are supportive and friendly, always quick to offer feedback and help improve your form so that you get the most out of a workout and improve every time.

Name: Heather Colquhoun
Review: Had such a fab class and experience with Alice - she was so welcoming and made the class an all round great experience!

Name: Louisa May Pope
Review: I've enjoyed 5 lovely classes here at Studio Glide so far! The teachers are amazing, I find the classes are at the perfect level of being doable but also challenging, allowing you to push yourself each session. The teachers also allow you to change the springs accordingly to make it easier/harder!The studio is sooo well presented, it always smells really fresh and the equipment is clean, easy to use and there is a wide range of additional equipment that the teachers blend into each class.I can't wait to come back soon! I wanted to mention as a suggestion that it would be great to see some focused classes targeting specific muscle groups (if this is a thing in pilates). For example, a glute and ab specific workout, or just arms/legs for the whole session? One of the days I visited I had a slight injury to my knee so it would have been helpful to maybe just do an upper body/ab focused reformer workout on that day - just a suggestion for if this is possible!I'd also love to do a session that incorporates meditation and maybe journalling too if this would be something that you offer? The studio is very calming so I feel it would be a great use of the space especially as personal growth and wellness is very popular!Thank you again, see you soon!

Name: Grace Dessillas
Review: This Pilates studio is a true gem! As someone who’s never done reformer Pilates before, this studio made me feel fabulous! The space is beautiful and relaxing, and the instructors are super professional and supportive. Highly recommend!

Name: Georgie Dustin
Review: Such a welcoming and beautiful space! Reformer beds are amazing quality and the instructors are so warm and supportive. Great studio for newbies and Pilates obsessive alike.

Name: Sarah Barham
Review: I love the classes at glide. The instructors all have their own style and the space is lovely and bright.

Name: Tansy Tiernan
Review: All the instructors are so friendly and helpful! I’ve done 7 classes at Studio Glide now and I’ve loved every single one. I’ll definitely be continuing with reformer here!

Name: Samantha Draper
Review: Excellent studio and the instructors are great and very knowledgeable.. I love ever class I go to..

Name: Michelle Newton
Review: Great studio- calm, clean with everything you need. Instructors are friendly and knowledgeable. You will leave a session feeling like you’ve been challenged, that you have accomplished something and maybe a little achy.

Name: Ellie O'Kill
Review: Loved my experience at the studio! It was my first time trying reformer Pilates but Koti made me feel so comfortable and explained everything to me. Will be visiting again✨

Name: Meera Bakrania
Review: I've been attending the postnatal classes and it's been a great way for me to get back into exercise. I look forward to going every Friday

Name: Mia Antoniades
Review: Studio Glide is a beautifully calm and welcoming Pilates Reformer studio with a thoughtful, educated approach to movement. The atmosphere is serene, and the instructors bring a fun, spicy energy that keeps things exciting and motivating.

Name: KRS Services
Review: One of the reasons that signed up for a 2-week trial was that I had recently been diagnosed with bipolar and I hoped that the combination of exercise and getting me out the house would help me manage my symptoms. I have been blown away by both the positive physical and mental results I have experienced. On the physical side I have seen a significant change in my body tone in just 2 weeks ( ok.. I did do 12 classes in those 2 weeks but still it’s such a marked improvement, especially in my arms which were my 'problem' area)On the mental side the results have been astonishing. It has improved my mood and focus greatly. There is such a lovely atmosphere in the studio, the instructors are so kind and caring and I’ve also met some lovely classmates along the way. I didn't think I’d be able to justify paying for membership after the trial and was only going to have the intensive 2 weeks.
